title: Canvas Assignment Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=canvas:assignment
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by course_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Canvas assignment data has stopped arriving for a given course name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per course name and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when one part of your Canvas assignment feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
